name: Imitation ~Manatsu no Ai~
source:
The protagonist acquired the right to test an android imitation from a famous company for one month. At first he does not take it seriously, but with time starts to feel sympathy towards Mizuki. With each day time limit draws near - is farewell inevitable?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公获得了一家知名公司生产的仿生人“Imitation”的一个月试用资格。起初他并没有把这件事放在心上，但随着时间流逝，他开始对美月产生感情。期限一天天逼近——这场离别真的无法避免吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
